checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: local sync server, Android APK build, phone APK page, English/public-safety and UI consolidation

impact_assessment.why: CardMon needed LAN sync with Android, an APK build reachable from the phone browser, and a clean public-release surface.
impact_assessment.benefits: One-click server, auto-discovery, on-demand APK build, English-first UI, no personal data, one home per action.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive APIs and new modules; dependency: none beyond Node stdlib and the local Android SDK; concurrency: one build job at a time; state: revisioned portfolio file.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for server/client/build/UI, explicit staging, 4/4 gates, and a UI surface task with reviewed verification.
